get.description: Retrieves a list of comments on an article translation, with pagination support.

parameters.name: articleId
parameters.description: Unique ID of the article containing the comment

parameters.name: locale
parameters.description: Language locale of the comment to retrieve

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: Additional information to include in the response. Possible values:ticket

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of comments to fetch

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Index number from which comments must be fetched. Default is 5

parameters.name: sortBy
parameters.description: Sorts comments by the specified attribute. Default sorting order is ascending. Prefix the value with a hyphen (-) to sort in descending order.Possible values:commentedTime

post.description: Adds a comment to a specific article translation.

parameters.name: articleId
parameters.description: Unique ID of the article containing the comment

parameters.description: Locale of the article translation to which the comment must be added

post.description: Approves the specified article translation comments.

requestBody.description: ID(s) of the article comments to approve

post.summary: Move KB Comments to Recycle Bin
post.description: Moves the specified KB article translation comments to the Recycle Bin.

requestBody.description: ID(s) of the article translation comment(s) to move to the Recycle Bin

get.description: Retrieves all available moderated comments from the knowledge base, with pagination support.

parameters.name: locale
parameters.description: Filters comments by the specified language locale

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of moderated comments to fetch

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Index number from which moderated comments must be fetched

parameters.name: commentedBy
parameters.description: Filters comments to those added by the specified user

parameters.name: categoryId
parameters.description: Filters comments to those in the specified category

parameters.name: sortBy
parameters.description: Sorts comments by the specified attribute. Default sorting order is ascending. Prefix the value with a hyphen (-) to sort in descending order. Possible values:commentedTime

schema.description: Sorts comments by the specified attribute. Default sorting order is ascending. Prefix the value with a hyphen (-) to sort in descending order. Possible values:commentedTime

get.description: Retrieves the total count of moderated comments from the knowledge base.

parameters.name: locale
parameters.description: Filters the count by the specified language locale

parameters.name: categoryId
parameters.description: Filters the count by the specified category

parameters.name: commentedBy
parameters.description: Filters the count to comments added by the specified user

200.description: Total number of moderated KB comments matching the specified filters
